protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed CWE-502: Concrete CMS 9.5.1 has five unrestricted unserialize() sinks over session, database, file-cache, configuration, and user-configuration data; 9.5.2 restricts allowed_classes at each sink. The live CNA record is PUBLISHED and the vendor 9.5.2 notes identify this mechanism.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 6c4fb938c3b4b744a192bd7642db2962ab83de56 as the earliest case sink first-write: its patch adds IndexedSearch::getSavedSearchableAreas() and unserialize(Config::get('SEARCH_INDEX_AREA_LIST')). It is a single-parent commit and the smallest reachable public commit object writing that sink.
